title: 11  片头文字开场动画效果.mp4
origin: User-provided local Jianying tutorial; abstracted principles, not a bundled preset.

route_semantics.typed: Supported technique.2.0 fields; build and validate an explicit graph.
route_semantics.recipe: Executable builder producing a typed graph.
route_semantics.workflow: Existing main workflow; separate confirmation and evidence remain required.
route_semantics.external: Not bundled; exact resource/voice/preset needs explicit licensed input.
route_semantics.knowledge: Planning abstraction only; no new automatic detector or segmentation implementation.

techniques.name: 独立字层构成有大小变化的片头标题
techniques.intent: 为每个字设置位置、尺寸与透明度，再与副标题组成可调整的整体。

timing.rule: Independent layers share the chosen title interval; the demonstrated layers start together, not a proven staggered start.

pitfalls: Exact glyph appearance requires matching available font assets; screen-visible font names do not establish licensing.
75% is a visual choice for this sky background, not a universal contrast rule.
Do not infer staggered starts merely because the glyphs are on different tracks.
The optional English wording is tutorial text, not a mandatory title for other footage.
validation: View title at full delivery size for contrast and safe margins.
Check glyph bounding boxes for accidental overlaps and clipping.
Check subtitle width and optical alignment without stretching text disproportionately.

techniques.name: 逐字入场运动与一致的出场
techniques.intent: 将片头动画分解为各层的移动与透明度曲线。

timing.rule: u=t-layer_start; entrance in[0,d_in], hold until D-d_out, exit in[D-d_out,D]; reject or explicitly resolve overlapping phases.

pitfalls: A named Jianying preset does not define a reproducible mathematical curve.
Incorrectly copied animation on one glyph can disrupt the group; tutorial itself demonstrates this correction.
Do not turn uncertain ASR animation labels into exact capability claims.
validation: Inspect entrance, hold and exit frames for every glyph and subtitle.
All layers reach their intended final positions before exit starts.
No clipping during offscreen entrance; common exit ends together when intended.

techniques.name: 音乐尾部淡出与可选环境音分轨
techniques.intent: 将片头的音乐与补充环境音明确作为独立音轨。

timing.rule: Audio output must end at chosen picture end; preserve intended music silence only after audition.

pitfalls: The claim that music begins silently and contains bird sounds remains unverified without audition.
Library ambience must retain provenance and permissions; it cannot be described as location sound.
Optional sound should not be added to a mute-all or original-only request.
validation: Audition actual mixed start/end and check levels.
Confirm audio duration matches video and optional assets have known provenance.

unknowns: No audio audition or continuous playback performed.
ASR is unverified, especially animation labels and English font name.
Exact motion curves, distances, font metrics and library asset rights remain unknown.
